intervention.name: rivl_plus2
intervention.notes: Model-dependent stress test. RIVL was top-ranked in one worm, but random neurons produced effects of similar or larger magnitude. Not causally validated.

causal_status.label: MODEL-DEPENDENT VIRTUAL PERTURBATION — NOT CAUSALLY VALIDATED.
reasons: The dynamics model was fitted only to observational recordings.
No randomized or targeted perturbation of these neurons was performed.
Latent state, model class, and noise assumptions are not identified from data.

notes: 10.6% of intervention states lie beyond the 99th percentile of training latent support
Amplitude is large in standardized model units; interpret as a stress test, not a dose
